{{Quote|Was I muttering to myself, Gel? Sorry, I guess I'm getting more like my old teacher every day. I'll have to introduce you to my master when we get to Coruscant.|Suljo Warde to Gel Marcolf|<ref name="CotG" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|female]] '''Jedi Master''' trained the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Suljo Warde]] in the ways of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. While serving as a [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] during the war, Warde remembered the phrase "Knowledge is the heaviest burden," in his master's voice, but could not remember if it was actually something that she had said or if it simply matched the heavy-handed wisdom that she tended to share. Warde decided that he would ask his master if what he remembered was true after returning to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="CotG" />
